name: Sun & Dawn Fire Faith
description: Establish a solar priesthood venerating the dawn with mountain peak fire braziers and solar hymns.
creativePrompt: What holy scriptures do the solar priests engrave? What occurs during a total solar eclipse?
exampleNarrative: At every sunrise, priests climbed the highest peak to kindle the sacred fire, proclaiming the triumph of light.

name: Lunar Mystery & Tide Chant
description: Weave nighttime lunar rituals honoring the phases of the moons and the rhythms of ocean tides.
creativePrompt: What secret knowledge is whispered only beneath the full moon? Who are the lunar seers?
exampleNarrative: Beneath the silver arc of the new moon, hooded chanters walked the tide pools singing secret sea-psalms.

name: Iron Shieldwall Oath
description: Instill an unbreakable martial tradition where youth swear lifelong loyalty to their shield-siblings.
creativePrompt: What sacred trial must every warrior endure before locking shields with the warband?
exampleNarrative: Locking heavy oaken shields rim to rim, the youth swore the blood oath: to fall together or stand unbroken.

name: Ancestor Spirit Veneration
description: Preserve the skulls and memory of honoured forebears in sacred barrow cairns and memory halls.
creativePrompt: How do the living consult the spirits of their grandmothers and chieftains before battle?
exampleNarrative: Tallow candles burned before the carved bone masks of the founders, whose counsel guided every clan moot.

name: Oral Skaldic Lorekeeping
description: Train memory-singers who memorize generational lineages, heroic triumphs, and ancient law codes.
creativePrompt: What happens to a clan whose skald dies without teaching their songs to an apprentice?
exampleNarrative: Around the peat fire, the master skald recited eighty generations of kings and voyages without missing a syllable.

name: Sacred Salt & Bread Hospitality
description: Enshrine an inviolable guest-right: anyone who shares salt and bread under your roof is sacred from harm.
creativePrompt: What curse falls upon a host who draws steel upon a guest after offering salt and hearth?
exampleNarrative: Even mortal enemies laid down their spears upon breaking the salted loaf, bound by the ancient law of the hearth.

name: Solstice & Harvest Festival
description: Celebrate the turning of the seasons with communal feasts, athletic contests, and spirit masquerades.
creativePrompt: What symbolic effigy is burned at the solstice? What truce is declared during the feast weeks?
exampleNarrative: Clans from across the hills set aside ancient feuds to dance beneath the great wicker stag as winter turned to spring.

name: Communion of the Star-Spirits
description: Perform a celestial trance ritual allowing elders to communicate directly with astral deities in the void.
creativePrompt: What prophecy was imparted during the first communion? What celestial sign heralds the trance?
exampleNarrative: As meteor dust drifted through the shrine, the shamans spoke in the ringing harmony of distant stars.
